# Labels for the model calibration of the review on its new prompt: the pre-enforcement gate of
# ADR 0107 (no false pass on a blocking problem, at most 10 percent false fails among the pull
# requests labeled pass, no screen reject and no steering flag on a legitimate pull request). The
# owner's step before the review check is required. Neither CI nor the platform runs it: it calls
# the Anthropic API with the operator's own key, and every review costs money.
#
# Format: one pull request per line, `<dataset>#<number> <label> <base> <head>`, with the two
# commits copied from set-a.txt (or from set B's set-b.txt for a synthetic case). <label> is what a
# person expects the review to answer: pass, fail or uncertain. A line whose label is still `?` is
# not labeled yet, and calibrate refuses the whole file until every `?` is replaced. Blank lines
# and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a comment line heads each group of entries.
#
# Run on a labeled copy, from the frozen clones:
#   ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... bun run scripts/ci/pr-review-calibrate.ts --offline --clones DIR \
#     --prs labels.txt
# `--offline` changes only git; the reviews run one after another, and a large one can take about
# 21 minutes.
#
# The entries are added from the evidence run of set A.
